title: Bind active worker claims to their issuing coordinator
summary: Bind each worker claim to the exact coordinator URL and authentication token that issued it, retain that affinity for heartbeat/terminal retries, and fail closed across restart without persisting token material.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W01-024. Running worker settings hot apply previously redirected heartbeats and done/release reports for an existing claim to a new coordinator or auth epoch, allowing stale reclaim and duplicate processing.
behavior_before: Every worker HTTP request read the mutable global coordinator URL/token. Saving new connection settings during an encode silently migrated the active claim's heartbeat and terminal report; restart recovery had no issuing-coordinator identity evidence.
behavior_after: The claim request returns the exact HTTP context it used and the worker binds that context to the job ID. Heartbeats, unstartable releases, done/release, and same-process pending retries use the bound context while future idle requests use new settings. Durable state stores only issuing URL and token SHA-256 fingerprint; restart recovery holds instead of posting when current connection identity differs.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_lifecycle_fixes.py: active claim HTTP routing remains on the issuing URL/token after running settings hot apply, and save evidence reports preserved affinity without exposing the token.

tests/python/desktop/test_network_done_release.py: accepted terminal reporting uses and then forgets the issuing context; failed terminal reporting retains it for pending retry; restart with changed identity holds state and sends nothing while persisting no raw token.
